title: Structures and formulas for filtered derived operations
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and use finite filtered localization [def-trf-finite-filtered-localization], decreasing filtrations [def-sp-filtration] and their complex subquotients [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. A filtered lift of an ordinary functor $D^+(\mathcal A)\to D^+(\mathcal B)$ consists of functors on each optional finite interval, shift and triangulated structures, and natural total and graded comparisons. An exact termwise lift additionally records its additive action on filtered objects, the underlying-object comparison, step comparisons commuting with inclusions, and the homotopy-localization comparison. A filtered adjunction records an adjunction at each interval whose total and graded units and counits are the ordinary ones. For finite commutative coefficients on the small pro-etale sites, use the canonical ordinary inverse and direct images [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero], and compactification candidate [def-weil-compact-support-candidate]. The structures additionally record their canonical pullback identity/composition coherence, the actual functor formalisms, finite operation expressions and canonical mate expressions, evaluation comparisons, clopen adjunctions, and the vertical and refinement pasting equations for the actual compactification maps. All fields and formulas are the unchanged structures formerly declared in Sheaf.CategoryTheory.FilteredDerivedOperationLifts; none asserts existence of these records.
